key_findings.root_cause: Hip yaw divergence causes sagittal position error, not pure CoM drift
key_findings.D2_issue: High hip_yaw_abs_max (0.31 rad) but position correction causes even more yaw
key_findings.E2_fix: Reduced position correction authority, hip_yaw dropped to 0.13 rad
key_findings.E2_tradeoff: Improved hip_yaw but position error crossings still high (62 normalized)

recommended_approach.principle: Phase-aware recentering with safe pitch detection
recommended_approach.key_signal: pitch_x and pitch_rate to detect dangerous vs recovering state
recommended_approach.secondary_signal: hip_yaw_abs_max to avoid position corrections that worsen yaw
recommended_approach.recenter_trigger: When pitch is recovering AND support_error > deadband AND hip_yaw bounded
recommended_approach.recenter_strength: Bounded, proportional to signed support error
